description: Sail makes transportation choices simpler and more transparent. Find places and compare estimated prices, pickup times, and availability across ride-hailing services in 24+ countries. Where public transport coverage is available, Sail can also plan journeys with fares, walking directions, transfers, and boarding guidance. Compare available options for the same trip and choose what works best for you. Sail is read-only and does not book, track, or cancel rides. Results are estimates and may change before travel.

defaultPrompt: Compare ride-hailing and public transport options from Accra Mall to Osu.
